basics.name: Cláudio da Silva Araújo Filho
basics.title: Mid-level Backend Developer @ Avanade
basics.summary: Mid-level Back-end Developer specialized in Java, Kotlin, and Spring Boot, with experience developing and modernizing enterprise applications for the banking and energy sectors. I work on building REST APIs, microservices, and integrations using Java 21, Spring WebFlux, Docker, OpenShift, Oracle, and PostgreSQL. Experience in evolving Java 8 legacy systems, migrating to microservices architectures, performance optimization, concurrent processing, and resolving production incidents. I apply Clean Architecture, Hexagonal Architecture, DDD, and automated testing to build scalable and maintainable solutions.

projects.name: HSG HIS Web App
projects.description: Web platform for managing hospital information.

projects.name: mock-smith
projects.description: Runtime API mocking engine driven by OpenAPI/Swagger — spins up an HTTP server straight from the contract, with chaos profiles and an interceptor pipeline.

projects.name: sellvia-api
projects.description: API REST backend for managing catalogs and products, developed with Kotlin and Spring Boot. The system includes authentication, company administration, product and category management, and digital asset storage via Cloudflare R2.

projects.name: sellvia-android
projects.description: Sellvia Android is the app for the Sellvia platform, focused on managing products, categories, catalog, and company information. The application consumes a REST API and follows the principles of Clean Architecture with the MVVM pattern.

projects.name: Personal Portfolio
projects.description: Modern, responsive, and multilingual personal portfolio website — built with Next.js 14, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. Single-page application (SPA) with location-based routing, fluid animations, and interactive 3D backgrounds. All content is powered by versioned static data files integrated with the code, without dependency on external APIs.

projects.name: EventSync API
projects.description: This project consists of a notification API that sends messages via both email (using Spring Boot Starter Mail) and SMS (using the Twilio API).

projects.name: go-microservices-architecture
projects.description: This repository is a monorepo containing a microservices architecture developed in Go, using an event-driven approach (EDA) with RabbitMQ as the event bus. The project simulates a decoupled user registration system, where different services communicate through events, allowing scalability, flexibility, and independence between components.

projects.name: go-task-api
projects.description: API back-end for managing tasks developed in Go. The project uses secure hashing for passwords, authentication via JWT token, and API documentation with Swagger.

projects.name: LibraryControl
projects.description: LibraryControl is a REST API for managing book rentals, created as a personal challenge. The goal was to go beyond the ordinary: developing everything without frameworks, using pure Java, with the fewest libraries possible. The idea was to explore what happens behind the scenes in Java applications — understanding how each part works, from route creation to authentication and data persistence, without relying on the abstraction of frameworks.

projects.name: To-do-List
projects.description: This is a To-Do List project developed as part of my learning process, challenging me to go beyond common implementations. Instead of limiting myself to HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, I decided to explore creating a more robust To-Do List with a React frontend and a Java backend using Spring Boot.

projects.name: TCAteliê E-commerce Platform
projects.description: A full-stack e-commerce platform developed for a real client (TCAteliê), focused on expanding digital presence and increasing sales. The solution includes a web storefront and an administrative dashboard available on both web and Android, enabling efficient business management. The infrastructure evolved from Azure to AWS, applying modern cloud architecture and Infrastructure as Code practices.

projects.name: VisualOps - Hardware Monitoring
projects.description: A hardware monitoring system designed for graphic design companies, enabling real-time tracking of CPU, memory, disk, and GPU usage. The solution includes interactive dashboards, Slack-based alerting, and historical data storage for analysis. The project applied ITIL concepts and focused on observability, system reliability, and proactive issue detection.

projects.name: IoT Monitoring & Web Platform
projects.description: An academic project focused on integrating web systems with IoT devices, developed using Scrum methodology and delivered across three sprints. The solution includes a data visualization dashboard, authentication system, database modeling, and full integration between Arduino sensors and backend services, enabling real-time data collection and analysis.

education.degree: Associate Degree in Systems Analysis and Development

experience.description: Development of microservices and BFFs using Java 21 and Spring Boot for the banking sector. Implementation of reactive APIs with Spring WebFlux and Project Reactor. Application of Hexagonal Architecture, DDD, and Clean Architecture in building new features. Implementation of resilience patterns with Resilience4j (Retry and Circuit Breaker). Development of an internal tool in Go for automatic HTTP mock generation from OpenAPI contracts, reducing inter-team dependencies. Participation in evolving Mainframe-integrated applications. Management of GitOps environments with ArgoCD. Development of Angular components for FED applications using WebViews.

Development and evolution of mission-critical Java applications for one of the largest clients in the energy sector, ensuring stability and service continuity. Maintenance of legacy systems built with Java 8, JSF, and PrimeFaces. Implementation of parallel processing for exporting large data volumes, eliminating timeouts and enabling processing of records spanning over six years of history. Administration of Red Hat OpenShift environments, supporting deployments and troubleshooting. Acted as a technical reference within the team, assisting with impact analysis and issue resolution in distributed systems. Investigation and resolution of production incidents.

Development of REST APIs using Java and Spring Boot with focus on scalability and performance. Development of frontend interfaces using React and TypeScript. Evolution of legacy systems built with Java 8, JSF, PrimeFaces, and EJB. Participation in modernizing applications toward microservices architecture. Application of unit and integration testing using JUnit and Mockito. Active participation in Scrum ceremonies and Sprint Reviews with the client.

Development and maintenance of Java 8 applications. Building REST APIs using Spring Boot. Development of React interfaces. Used tools like Git and SonarLint for version control and code quality. Participated in agile ceremonies and code reviews. Promoted to Junior Developer after 10 months due to strong performance and contributions to the projects.
